title: Federal Reserve Under New Chair Kevin Warsh Launches Five Monetary-Policy Task Forces
detail: The Federal Reserve announced five task forces — Communications, Balance Sheet Policy, Data, Productivity and Jobs (including AI's economic impact), and Inflation Frameworks — each pairing external experts with Fed staff. Chairman Kevin Warsh, who took office in May 2026, said the review reflects how much the economy has changed and reaffirmed the Fed's commitment to its mandate amid persistently elevated inflation.

media.caption: Federal Reserve announces five monetary-policy task forces under new Chair Kevin Warsh
